name: IDevelop starter capability framework
note: A small, generic, cross-industry framework so a fresh installation is usable on day one. Edit, extend or delete it freely from Domains & Skills. Level anchors come from the per-category proficiency descriptors shipped with the schema.

subDomains.name: Leading teams
subDomains.definition: Set direction, share responsibility and keep a team focused on outcomes.

skills.name: Setting direction
skills.fr: Donne un cap clair à l'équipe et relie le travail quotidien aux objectifs.
skills.en: Gives the team a clear direction and links daily work to objectives.

skills.name: Delegation & empowerment
skills.fr: Confie des responsabilités adaptées et laisse l'autonomie nécessaire pour les assumer.
skills.en: Hands over suitable responsibilities and the autonomy needed to carry them.

skills.name: Giving feedback
skills.fr: Donne un retour factuel, régulier et utile, positif comme correctif.
skills.en: Gives factual, regular and useful feedback, both positive and corrective.

subDomains.name: Developing people
subDomains.definition: Help each person progress through coaching, fair evaluation and planned development.

skills.name: Coaching
skills.fr: Aide une personne à trouver ses propres solutions par le questionnement et l'écoute.
skills.en: Helps a person find their own solutions through questions and listening.

skills.name: Performance conversations
skills.fr: Conduit des entretiens d'évaluation équitables, fondés sur des faits et orientés vers l'avenir.
skills.en: Runs fair, fact-based and forward-looking performance conversations.

skills.name: Development planning
skills.fr: Construit avec la personne un plan de développement réaliste et suivi.
skills.en: Builds a realistic, followed-up development plan together with the person.

pillars.name: Collaboration & Communication
pillars.description: Working with others and communicating clearly.

subDomains.name: Communication
subDomains.definition: Share information clearly, in writing and orally, and listen actively.

skills.name: Written communication
skills.fr: Rédige des messages et documents clairs, structurés et adaptés au lecteur.
skills.en: Writes clear, structured messages and documents suited to the reader.

skills.name: Presenting
skills.fr: Présente une idée ou un résultat de manière claire et convaincante.
skills.en: Presents an idea or a result clearly and convincingly.

skills.name: Active listening
skills.fr: Écoute pour comprendre, reformule et vérifie sa compréhension.
skills.en: Listens to understand, rephrases and checks understanding.

subDomains.name: Teamwork
subDomains.definition: Cooperate across teams, handle disagreement and keep stakeholders aligned.

skills.name: Cross-functional collaboration
skills.fr: Travaille efficacement avec d'autres équipes vers un objectif commun.
skills.en: Works effectively with other teams toward a shared goal.

skills.name: Conflict resolution
skills.fr: Traite les désaccords tôt et de façon constructive.
skills.en: Addresses disagreements early and constructively.

skills.name: Stakeholder management
skills.fr: Identifie les parties prenantes, gère leurs attentes et les tient informées.
skills.en: Identifies stakeholders, manages their expectations and keeps them informed.

pillars.name: Digital & Data
pillars.description: Using digital tools and data safely and effectively.

subDomains.name: Digital workplace
subDomains.definition: Use everyday digital tools productively and securely.

skills.name: Office productivity tools
skills.fr: Utilise efficacement traitement de texte, tableur et présentation.
skills.en: Uses word processing, spreadsheets and presentation tools effectively.

skills.name: Collaboration platforms
skills.fr: Partage, co-édite et organise l'information sur les outils collaboratifs.
skills.en: Shares, co-edits and organises information on collaboration platforms.

skills.name: Information security hygiene
skills.fr: Protège ses accès, reconnaît l'hameçonnage et signale les incidents.
skills.en: Protects credentials, recognises phishing and reports incidents.

subDomains.name: Data & analysis
subDomains.definition: Read, analyse and present data to support decisions.

skills.name: Data literacy
skills.fr: Comprend l'origine, la qualité et les limites d'une donnée.
skills.en: Understands where data comes from, its quality and its limits.

skills.name: Spreadsheet analysis
skills.fr: Nettoie, analyse et synthétise des données dans un tableur.
skills.en: Cleans, analyses and summarises data in a spreadsheet.

skills.name: Reporting & dashboards
skills.fr: Construit des indicateurs et tableaux de bord lisibles et fiables.
skills.en: Builds readable, reliable indicators and dashboards.

subDomains.name: Process excellence
subDomains.definition: Plan work, meet quality standards and improve how work is done.

skills.name: Planning & scheduling
skills.fr: Planifie les activités et les ressources pour tenir les délais.
skills.en: Plans activities and resources to meet deadlines.

skills.name: Quality management
skills.fr: Applique les standards de qualité et traite les non-conformités.
skills.en: Applies quality standards and handles non-conformities.

skills.name: Continuous improvement
skills.fr: Identifie les pertes et met en œuvre des améliorations mesurables.
skills.en: Spots waste and implements measurable improvements.

subDomains.name: Project delivery
subDomains.definition: Deliver projects on scope, time and budget while managing risk.

skills.name: Project management
skills.fr: Cadre, pilote et clôture un projet en maîtrisant périmètre, délais et coûts.
skills.en: Scopes, runs and closes a project, controlling scope, time and cost.

skills.name: Risk management
skills.fr: Identifie, évalue et traite les risques d'une activité ou d'un projet.
skills.en: Identifies, assesses and treats the risks of an activity or project.

skills.name: Budget management
skills.fr: Prépare et suit un budget, explique les écarts.
skills.en: Prepares and tracks a budget and explains variances.

pillars.name: Health, Safety & Environment
pillars.description: Keeping people safe and limiting environmental impact.

subDomains.name: Workplace safety
subDomains.definition: Recognise hazards, prevent incidents and respond to emergencies.

skills.name: Hazard identification
skills.fr: Repère les dangers de son poste et applique les mesures de prévention.
skills.en: Spots the hazards of the job and applies preventive measures.

skills.name: Incident reporting
skills.fr: Signale sans délai incidents et presque-accidents, avec les faits utiles.
skills.en: Reports incidents and near-misses promptly, with the relevant facts.

skills.name: Emergency response
skills.fr: Connaît et applique les consignes d'urgence et d'évacuation.
skills.en: Knows and follows emergency and evacuation procedures.

subDomains.name: Environmental stewardship
subDomains.definition: Reduce the environmental footprint of daily activities.

skills.name: Environmental awareness
skills.fr: Connaît les impacts environnementaux de son activité et les limite.
skills.en: Knows the environmental impacts of the work and limits them.

skills.name: Waste & resource management
skills.fr: Trie les déchets et utilise l'énergie et les ressources avec sobriété.
skills.en: Sorts waste and uses energy and resources sparingly.

pillars.name: Compliance & Ethics
pillars.description: Acting lawfully, ethically and in line with company policy.

subDomains.name: Regulatory compliance
subDomains.definition: Apply the rules that govern data, conduct and procedures.

skills.name: Personal data protection
skills.fr: Traite les données personnelles conformément à la réglementation (ex. RGPD).
skills.en: Handles personal data in line with regulation (e.g. GDPR).

skills.name: Business ethics & anti-corruption
skills.fr: Reconnaît et refuse les situations de conflit d'intérêts ou de corruption.
skills.en: Recognises and refuses conflicts of interest and bribery.

skills.name: Policy & procedure compliance
skills.fr: Connaît et applique les politiques et procédures qui s'appliquent à son poste.
skills.en: Knows and applies the policies and procedures relevant to the role.

subDomains.name: Certification & audit
subDomains.definition: Keep mandatory training current and be ready for audits.

skills.name: Mandatory training currency
skills.fr: Maintient à jour ses formations et habilitations obligatoires.
skills.en: Keeps mandatory training and authorisations up to date.

skills.name: Audit readiness
skills.fr: Tient à jour les preuves et prépare les contrôles internes et externes.
skills.en: Keeps evidence current and prepares for internal and external audits.

roleFamilies.name: Operations
roleFamilies.description: Roles that plan, run and improve operations.

roleFamilies.name: Support Functions
roleFamilies.description: HR, finance, legal and administrative roles.
